runs.name: g3-lab-refold-colonies
runs.description: lab: colonies s3, refolding in life off from 200 s; by hand: all home at 200 s, all into the STRESS fold at 240 s, all home at 270 s; the phenotype (output factors) compared per cell 30 s apart

evals.js: const s = await moire.sample(); const job = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(k => Math.round(s['census.job.' + k] || 0)); return JSON.stringify({t: moire.time(), alive: s.alive, job, fold: moire.folding.panelLine(true)})
